response.justification: While this candidate demonstrates strong general software engineering fundamentals and excellent communication skills, they critically lack the mandatory technical requirements for this role. They have minimal C++ experience (~6 months ending in 2015), no demonstrated Windows platform expertise, no SQL Server/Oracle background, and zero exposure to capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domains. The career trajectory shows deep specialization in web, mobile, and open-source technologies—fundamentally misaligned with financial systems development.
strengths: Extensive 20-year software development career with proven ability to learn diverse languages and platforms
Excellent communication and knowledge-sharing demonstrated through conference talks, workshops, and training courses
Strong CI/CD and DevOps infrastructure experience, including GitLab administration, Docker, and automated deployment systems
concerns: Minimal and heavily outdated C++ experience (~6 months, last used professionally in 2015), far below the mandatory 5–10 years requirement
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; career has focused on MongoDB and MySQL rather than enterprise financial databases
Zero domain expertise in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking; career has centered on web, mobile, GIS, and open-source projects instead
